title: Structured Data
description: Adds schema.org JSON-LD structured data to every page so search engines and AI assistants can understand your site, posts, and author.

fields.label: Author name (defaults to your Micro.blog account name)
Author URL (defaults to your site URL)
Extra profile URLs for sameAs, comma-separated (Mastodon, LinkedIn, etc.)
Publisher or organization name (leave blank to publish as yourself)
Publisher logo URL (used when a publisher name is set)
Include the full post text (articleBody) so AI crawlers get clean plain-text content
